content.text:
The full sequence of ATS status changes required from a candidate accepting a verbal offer and clearing a background check until onboarding is finalized in Payroll includes **Verbal Offer (External)**, **Written Offer**, **Start Backgrounds**, **Pre-Onboarding**, **Transfer to UKG Onboarding**, and finally, clicking **Submit for Processing** in UKG to finalize the hire for Payroll [[1](https://storage.googleapis.com/tools-universe-bucket/NRF-Store-SOP-Dec-2025/Job%20Offers%2C%20Backgrounds%20%26%20Onboarding%20SOP.pdf)].

### **Overview** 📌:
This process outlines the critical ATS status updates and system actions necessary to transition a candidate from a verbal offer acceptance through background clearance, formal offer, pre-onboarding, and ultimately, finalization in the UKG HR and Payroll system [[1](https://storage.googleapis.com/tools-universe-bucket/NRF-Store-SOP-Dec-2025/Job%20Offers%2C%20Backgrounds%20%26%20Onboarding%20SOP.pdf)]. **Each status change signifies a crucial milestone in the hiring journey, ensuring compliance, data accuracy, and a smooth transition for the new hire into the organization.** This structured approach minimizes errors and ensures all necessary steps are completed before a new employee is fully onboarded and ready for payroll [[1](https://storage.googleapis.com/tools-universe-bucket/NRF-Store-SOP-Dec-2025/Job%20Offers%2C%20Backgrounds%20%26%20Onboarding%20SOP.pdf)].

### **Steps** ✅:
1.  **Update to "Verbal Offer (External)" and "Written Offer"**
    Once a verbal offer is accepted by the candidate, their status in the ATS must be updated to "Verbal Offer (External)" [[1](https://storage.googleapis.com/tools-universe-bucket/NRF-Store-SOP-Dec-2025/Job%20Offers%2C%20Backgrounds%20%26%20Onboarding%20SOP.pdf)]. Following this, pay details are entered into the Offer Details tab, and the appropriate state-specific Offer Letter Template is selected. The iForm is then reviewed, and the "Send iForm" button is clicked to dispatch the written offer letter for e-signature, at which point the status is updated to "Written Offer" [[1](https://storage.googleapis.com/tools-universe-bucket/NRF-Store-SOP-Dec-2025/Job%20Offers%2C%20Backgrounds%20%26%20Onboarding%20SOP.pdf)]. This ensures formal documentation of the offer and initiates the candidate's commitment to the role.
2.  **Initiate Background Check with "Start Backgrounds"**
    To commence the background check process, the candidate's status is updated to "Start Backgrounds" [[1](https://storage.googleapis.com/tools-universe-bucket/NRF-Store-SOP-Dec-2025/Job%20Offers%2C%20Backgrounds%20%26%20Onboarding%20SOP.pdf)]. This action automatically triggers an email to the candidate from the background check vendor, prompting them to provide necessary information. The progress of this check is monitored via the Screen tab in the ATS, and the process can only proceed if the results indicate "MEETS" [[1](https://storage.googleapis.com/tools-universe-bucket/NRF-Store-SOP-Dec-2025/Job%20Offers%2C%20Backgrounds%20%26%20Onboarding%20SOP.pdf)]. This step is crucial for verifying candidate eligibility and mitigating hiring risks.
3.  **Launch Pre-Onboarding with "Pre-Onboarding" and "Transfer to UKG Onboarding"**
    Upon successful clearance of the background check (status "MEETS"), the candidate's status is updated to "Pre-Onboarding," and their confirmed Start Date is entered [[1](https://storage.googleapis.com/tools-universe-bucket/NRF-Store-SOP-Dec-2025/Job%20Offers%2C%20Backgrounds%20%26%20Onboarding%20SOP.pdf)]. Within the candidate's profile, the Onboarding Owner—the leader responsible for completing the I-9 form on the new hire's first day—must be selected. The final step in the ATS is to update the status to "Transfer to UKG Onboarding," which pushes all relevant candidate data to the HR system, UKG [[1](https://storage.googleapis.com/tools-universe-bucket/NRF-Store-SOP-Dec-2025/Job%20Offers%2C%20Backgrounds%20%26%20Onboarding%20SOP.pdf)]. This prepares the candidate for the formal onboarding process within the HR platform.
4.  **Finalize Onboarding in UKG and "Submit for Processing"**
    The final stages occur within UKG, starting with logging into the Onboarding Gateway and selecting the new hire [[1](https://storage.googleapis.com/tools-universe-bucket/NRF-Store-SOP-Dec-2025/Job%20Offers%2C%20Backgrounds%20%26%20Onboarding%20SOP.pdf)]. Job, Pay, and Personal information are verified, and "Launch Onboarding" is clicked, sending an email to the candidate to complete necessary paperwork like tax forms and Section 1 of the I-9. On Day 1, Section 1 of the I-9 is reviewed, original ID documents are physically inspected, Section 2 is completed in UKG, and the information is submitted to E-Verify [[1](https://storage.googleapis.com/tools-universe-bucket/NRF-Store-SOP-Dec-2025/Job%20Offers%2C%20Backgrounds%20%26%20Onboarding%20SOP.pdf)][[2](https://storage.googleapis.com/tools-universe-bucket/NRF-Store-SOP-Dec-2025/Recruiting%20%26%20Hiring%20for%20Stores%20SOP.pdf)]. Once E-Verify displays "Employment Authorized," the "Submit for Processing" button is clicked, which officially finalizes the hire for Payroll [[1](https://storage.googleapis.com/tools-universe-bucket/NRF-Store-SOP-Dec-2025/Job%20Offers%2C%20Backgrounds%20%26%20Onboarding%20SOP.pdf)][[2](https://storage.googleapis.com/tools-universe-bucket/NRF-Store-SOP-Dec-2025/Recruiting%20%26%20Hiring%20for%20Stores%20SOP.pdf)].

### **Edge cases and Restrictions ⚠️**:
*   **Background Check Results:** The background check status must indicate "MEETS" for the process to proceed to Pre-Onboarding [[1](https://storage.googleapis.com/tools-universe-bucket/NRF-Store-SOP-Dec-2025/Job%20Offers%2C%20Backgrounds%20%26%20Onboarding%20SOP.pdf)]. If results are "Review/Does Not Meet," instructions must be awaited from Recruiting or the Vendor before any further action is taken [[1](https://storage.googleapis.com/tools-universe-bucket/NRF-Store-SOP-Dec-2025/Job%20Offers%2C%20Backgrounds%20%26%20Onboarding%20SOP.pdf)].
*   **I-9 Completion:** Original ID documents must be physically inspected on the new hire's first day to complete Section 2 of the I-9 form [[1](https://storage.googleapis.com/tools-universe-bucket/NRF-Store-SOP-Dec-2025/Job%20Offers%2C%20Backgrounds%20%26%20Onboarding%20SOP.pdf)]. This is a mandatory compliance requirement.
*   **E-Verify Authorization:** The "Submit for Processing" action, which finalizes the hire for Payroll, can only be performed once E-Verify displays "Employment Authorized" [[1](https://storage.googleapis.com/tools-universe-bucket/NRF-Store-SOP-Dec-2025/Job%20Offers%2C%20Backgrounds%20%26%20Onboarding%20SOP.pdf)].

### **SOPs/Processes** 🧭:
• **Offer Process SOP**: This outlines the detailed steps for extending verbal and written offers, including template selection and iForm review [[1](https://storage.googleapis.com/tools-universe-bucket/NRF-Store-SOP-Dec-2025/Job%20Offers%2C%20Backgrounds%20%26%20Onboarding%20SOP.pdf)]. It ensures consistency and compliance in the offer stage.
• **Background Check Process**: This defines the initiation, monitoring, and resolution steps for candidate background checks, ensuring only eligible candidates proceed [[1](https://storage.googleapis.com/tools-universe-bucket/NRF-Store-SOP-Dec-2025/Job%20Offers%2C%20Backgrounds%20%26%20Onboarding%20SOP.pdf)].
• **Onboarding Launch Process**: This procedure details how to transition candidates from the ATS to UKG, including entering start dates and assigning onboarding owners [[1](https://storage.googleapis.com/tools-universe-bucket/NRF-Store-SOP-Dec-2025/Job%20Offers%2C%20Backgrounds%20%26%20Onboarding%20SOP.pdf)]. It's crucial for data integrity and smooth HR system integration.
• **UKG Onboarding Steps**: These are the comprehensive steps within UKG for new hires, covering paperwork, I-9 verification, E-Verify submission, and finalization for payroll [[1](https://storage.googleapis.com/tools-universe-bucket/NRF-Store-SOP-Dec-2025/Job%20Offers%2C%20Backgrounds%20%26%20Onboarding%20SOP.pdf)]. Adherence is critical for legal compliance and accurate payroll processing.


### **References:**
[1] [Job Offers, Backgrounds & Onboarding SOP.pdf](https://storage.googleapis.com/tools-universe-bucket/NRF-Store-SOP-Dec-2025/Job%20Offers%2C%20Backgrounds%20%26%20Onboarding%20SOP.pdf)
[2] [Recruiting & Hiring for Stores SOP.pdf](https://storage.googleapis.com/tools-universe-bucket/NRF-Store-SOP-Dec-2025/Recruiting%20%26%20Hiring%20for%20Stores%20SOP.pdf)

c36c4ecc-3b79-4182-ab1a-b277eb73e927.userInput: A Store Leader wants to issue $100 gift cards for a team recognition event. What is the correct end-to-end process they must follow according to the policy?

content.text:
A Store Leader, acting through the established District Team Leader (DTL) process, must follow a specific end-to-end process to issue $100 gift cards, which includes submitting a Gift Card Request Form to the Treasury department, allowing 10-14 business days for delivery, and meticulously completing and submitting a Gift Card Disbursement Log for tax reporting [[1](https://storage.googleapis.com/tools-universe-bucket/NRF-Store-SOP-Dec-2025/Gift%20Cards%20for%20Team%20Member%20Recognition%20SOP.pdf)][[2](https://storage.googleapis.com/tools-universe-bucket/NRF-Store-SOP-Dec-2025/Gift%20Cards%20and%20Other%20Employee%20Awards%20Policy.pdf)].
### **Overview** 📌: The process for issuing gift cards for team recognition ensures proper procurement, distribution, and accounting, especially since gift cards are considered taxable income [[1](https://storage.googleapis.com/tools-universe-bucket/NRF-Store-SOP-Dec-2025/Gift%20Cards%20for%20Team%20Member%20Recognition%20SOP.pdf)][[2](https://storage.googleapis.com/tools-universe-bucket/NRF-Store-SOP-Dec-2025/Gift%20Cards%20and%20Other%20Employee%20Awards%20Policy.pdf)]. **District Team Leaders (DTLs) are responsible for requesting and distributing gift cards for recognition, adhering to specific guidelines to ensure compliance with tax reporting requirements** [[1](https://storage.googleapis.com/tools-universe-bucket/NRF-Store-SOP-Dec-2025/Gift%20Cards%20for%20Team%20Member%20Recognition%20SOP.pdf)]. This structured approach prevents misuse, maintains budget adherence, and ensures accurate reporting to payroll for W-2 wages [[2](https://storage.googleapis.com/tools-universe-bucket/NRF-Store-SOP-Dec-2025/Gift%20Cards%20and%20Other%20Employee%20Awards%20Policy.pdf)].

### **Steps** ✅:
1.  **Initiate the Gift Card Request**: The District Team Leader (DTL) must email the Treasury department to request the gift cards, providing specific details [[1](https://storage.googleapis.com/tools-universe-bucket/NRF-Store-SOP-Dec-2025/Gift%20Cards%20for%20Team%20Member%20Recognition%20SOP.pdf)]. This email needs to specify the exact date the cards are needed, the desired denomination (in this case, $100), and the total quantity of cards required [[1](https://storage.googleapis.com/tools-universe-bucket/NRF-Store-SOP-Dec-2025/Gift%20Cards%20for%20Team%20Member%20Recognition%20SOP.pdf)]. Additionally, a Gift Card Request Form must be submitted, detailing the specific event or reason for the request [[2](https://storage.googleapis.com/tools-universe-bucket/NRF-Store-SOP-Dec-2025/Gift%20Cards%20and%20Other%20Employee%20Awards%20Policy.pdf)].
2.  **Receive and Secure Gift Cards**: After approval, Finance/Accounting will purchase the gift cards using a corporate card [[2](https://storage.googleapis.com/tools-universe-bucket/NRF-Store-SOP-Dec-2025/Gift%20Cards%20and%20Other%20Employee%20Awards%20Policy.pdf)]. The requested cards will be shipped via FedEx to the DTL's home address, and a signature is strictly required upon delivery to ensure secure receipt [[1](https://storage.googleapis.com/tools-universe-bucket/NRF-Store-SOP-Dec-2025/Gift%20Cards%20for%20Team%20Member%20Recognition%20SOP.pdf)]. DTLs should plan ahead, allowing 10 to 14 business days for the entire delivery process to be completed [[1](https://storage.googleapis.com/tools-universe-bucket/NRF-Store-SOP-Dec-2025/Gift%20Cards%20for%20Team%20Member%20Recognition%20SOP.pdf)].
3.  **Track and Log Disbursements**: Recipients of gift cards must be tracked diligently because these awards are considered taxable income [[1](https://storage.googleapis.com/tools-universe-bucket/NRF-Store-SOP-Dec-2025/Gift%20Cards%20for%20Team%20Member%20Recognition%20SOP.pdf)][[2](https://storage.googleapis.com/tools-universe-bucket/NRF-Store-SOP-Dec-2025/Gift%20Cards%20and%20Other%20Employee%20Awards%20Policy.pdf)]. The DTL is required to complete a Gift Card Disbursement Log, which must include the card amount, the quantity of cards, the date of disbursement, and the specific purpose of the award [[1](https://storage.googleapis.com/tools-universe-bucket/NRF-Store-SOP-Dec-2025/Gift%20Cards%20for%20Team%20Member%20Recognition%20SOP.pdf)]. For $100 gift cards, the recipient's name and signature are mandatory on this log [[1](https://storage.googleapis.com/tools-universe-bucket/NRF-Store-SOP-Dec-2025/Gift%20Cards%20for%20Team%20Member%20Recognition%20SOP.pdf)][[2](https://storage.googleapis.com/tools-universe-bucket/NRF-Store-SOP-Dec-2025/Gift%20Cards%20and%20Other%20Employee%20Awards%20Policy.pdf)].
4.  **Submit Disbursement Logs for Accounting**: The completed Gift Card Disbursement Log must be submitted to the Treasury department at the end of each fiscal month [[1](https://storage.googleapis.com/tools-universe-bucket/NRF-Store-SOP-Dec-2025/Gift%20Cards%20for%20Team%20Member%20Recognition%20SOP.pdf)]. These logs are then forwarded to Finance/Accounting for reconciliation, which subsequently provides the necessary data to Payroll for accurate tax reporting of awards valued over $50 [[2](https://storage.googleapis.com/tools-universe-bucket/NRF-Store-SOP-Dec-2025/Gift%20Cards%20and%20Other%20Employee%20Awards%20Policy.pdf)].

### **Edge cases and Restrictions** ⚠️:
*   **Budget Adherence:** The quarterly budget allocated for gift cards must not be exceeded under any circumstances [[1](https://storage.googleapis.com/tools-universe-bucket/NRF-Store-SOP-Dec-2025/Gift%20Cards%20for%20Team%20Member%20Recognition%20SOP.pdf)].
*   **Delivery Signature:** A signature is strictly required upon FedEx delivery of the gift cards to the DTL's home address [[1](https://storage.googleapis.com/tools-universe-bucket/NRF-Store-SOP-Dec-2025/Gift%20Cards%20for%20Team%20Member%20Recognition%20SOP.pdf)].
*   **Recipient Signature Requirement:** For gift cards valued over $50, such as the $100 cards, the recipient's name and signature are mandatory on the Gift Card Disbursement Log [[1](https://storage.googleapis.com/tools-universe-bucket/NRF-Store-SOP-Dec-2025/Gift%20Cards%20for%20Team%20Member%20Recognition%20SOP.pdf)][[2](https://storage.googleapis.com/tools-universe-bucket/NRF-Store-SOP-Dec-2025/Gift%20Cards%20and%20Other%20Employee%20Awards%20Policy.pdf)].
*   **Taxable Income:** Gift cards are considered taxable income and must be properly procured and tracked for W-2 wage reporting [[2](https://storage.googleapis.com/tools-universe-bucket/NRF-Store-SOP-Dec-2025/Gift%20Cards%20and%20Other%20Employee%20Awards%20Policy.pdf)].
*   **Prohibited Use for Small Rewards:** The Small Reward Program for $5 cards, which does not require tracking, must not be used for franchise employees, as they are not corporate employees [[1](https://storage.googleapis.com/tools-universe-bucket/NRF-Store-SOP-Dec-2025/Gift%20Cards%20for%20Team%20Member%20Recognition%20SOP.pdf)][[2](https://storage.googleapis.com/tools-universe-bucket/NRF-Store-SOP-Dec-2025/Gift%20Cards%20and%20Other%20Employee%20Awards%20Policy.pdf)].
*   **Policy Violations:** Improper use or failure to track awards can lead to corrective action, including potential termination of employment [[2](https://storage.googleapis.com/tools-universe-bucket/NRF-Store-SOP-Dec-2025/Gift%20Cards%20and%20Other%20Employee%20Awards%20Policy.pdf)].

### **SOPs/Processes** 🧭:
These standard operating procedures and processes ensure compliance and accurate record-keeping for gift card issuance.
*   **Gift Card Request and Distribution Guidelines**: These guidelines detail the specific steps for District Team Leaders (DTLs) to request gift cards from the Treasury department, including necessary information and expected delivery timelines [[1](https://storage.googleapis.com/tools-universe-bucket/NRF-Store-SOP-Dec-2025/Gift%20Cards%20for%20Team%20Member%20Recognition%20SOP.pdf)].
*   **Gift Card and Employee Awards Policy**: This policy outlines the overarching rules for purchasing, administering, and accounting for all gift cards and employee awards, emphasizing their taxable nature and the need for proper tracking and reporting [[2](https://storage.googleapis.com/tools-universe-bucket/NRF-Store-SOP-Dec-2025/Gift%20Cards%20and%20Other%20Employee%20Awards%20Policy.pdf)].
*   **Disbursement Log Management**: This process mandates the completion and monthly submission of the Gift Card Disbursement Log to the Treasury department, ensuring all recipient and award details are captured for reconciliation and tax reporting [[1](https://storage.googleapis.com/tools-universe-bucket/NRF-Store-SOP-Dec-2025/Gift%20Cards%20for%20Team%20Member%20Recognition%20SOP.pdf)][[2](https://storage.googleapis.com/tools-universe-bucket/NRF-Store-SOP-Dec-2025/Gift%20Cards%20and%20Other%20Employee%20Awards%20Policy.pdf)].

content.text:
No, Mike cannot unload the truck unsupervised, as non-certified new hires or those who fail training must always be supervised by a certified Leader when operating equipment [[1](https://storage.googleapis.com/tools-universe-bucket/NRF-Store-SOP-Dec-2025/Risk%20Management%20-%20Forklift%20Safety%20SOP.pdf)]. While Mike may have been certified at his previous job, the company requires initial training from a certified trainer within the organization, and certifications are equipment-specific [[1](https://storage.googleapis.com/tools-universe-bucket/NRF-Store-SOP-Dec-2025/Risk%20Management%20-%20Forklift%20Safety%20SOP.pdf)].

### **Overview** 📌:
Operating forklifts requires strict adherence to safety protocols and certification requirements to ensure productivity while mitigating significant dangers [[1](https://storage.googleapis.com/tools-universe-bucket/NRF-Store-SOP-Dec-2025/Risk%20Management%20-%20Forklift%20Safety%20SOP.pdf)]. This Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) aligns with OSHA Standard 1910.178, emphasizing that **every team member operating a forklift must receive initial training from a certified trainer** [[1](https://storage.googleapis.com/tools-universe-bucket/NRF-Store-SOP-Dec-2025/Risk%20Management%20-%20Forklift%20Safety%20SOP.pdf)]. This ensures that all operators are proficient with the specific equipment and safety guidelines relevant to our operations, even if they possess prior experience or certifications from other organizations [[1](https://storage.googleapis.com/tools-universe-bucket/NRF-Store-SOP-Dec-2025/Risk%20Management%20-%20Forklift%20Safety%20SOP.pdf)].

### **Edge cases and Restrictions ⚠️**:
• **Mandatory Supervision for New Hires:** Non-certified new hires or those who fail initial training are strictly required to be supervised by a certified Leader at all times when operating equipment [[1](https://storage.googleapis.com/tools-universe-bucket/NRF-Store-SOP-Dec-2025/Risk%20Management%20-%20Forklift%20Safety%20SOP.pdf)]. This policy ensures safety and proper procedure adherence during the onboarding period.
• **Equipment-Specific Certification:** Forklift certifications are specific to the type of equipment being operated [[1](https://storage.googleapis.com/tools-universe-bucket/NRF-Store-SOP-Dec-2025/Risk%20Management%20-%20Forklift%20Safety%20SOP.pdf)]. If a team member transfers to a location with different equipment, they must undergo re-certification for that specific machinery, regardless of their previous certification status [[1](https://storage.googleapis.com/tools-universe-bucket/NRF-Store-SOP-Dec-2025/Risk%20Management%20-%20Forklift%20Safety%20SOP.pdf)].
• **Certification Validity:** Certificates for forklift operation are valid for three years [[1](https://storage.googleapis.com/tools-universe-bucket/NRF-Store-SOP-Dec-2025/Risk%20Management%20-%20Forklift%20Safety%20SOP.pdf)]. Refresher training is mandated every three years or immediately following any incident involving forklift operation to maintain current safety standards [[1](https://storage.googleapis.com/tools-universe-bucket/NRF-Store-SOP-Dec-2025/Risk%20Management%20-%20Forklift%20Safety%20SOP.pdf)].
• **Minimum Certified Staff:** Each location must maintain a minimum of four certified team members to ensure adequate staffing for safe forklift operations [[1](https://storage.googleapis.com/tools-universe-bucket/NRF-Store-SOP-Dec-2025/Risk%20Management%20-%20Forklift%20Safety%20SOP.pdf)].

### **SOPs/Processes** 🧭:
- **Initial Training Requirement**: Every team member operating a forklift must receive initial training from a certified trainer to ensure compliance with safety standards and operational procedures [[1](https://storage.googleapis.com/tools-universe-bucket/NRF-Store-SOP-Dec-2025/Risk%20Management%20-%20Forklift%20Safety%20SOP.pdf)]. This training covers both theoretical knowledge and practical application for safe operation.
- **Daily Pre-Operation Checks**: Before each use, team members must complete a daily inspection log, checking critical components such as brakes, lights, horn, reverse beeper, tires, and the load rating plate [[2](https://storage.googleapis.com/tools-universe-bucket/NRF-Store-SOP-Dec-2025/Risk%20Management%20Forklift%20Safety%20Checklist.pdf)]. This ensures the equipment is in safe working condition and any issues are reported to the Store Team Leader immediately for maintenance [[2](https://storage.googleapis.com/tools-universe-bucket/NRF-Store-SOP-Dec-2025/Risk%20Management%20Forklift%20Safety%20Checklist.pdf)].
- **Reporting Issues**: Any problems identified during the daily inspection must be reported to the Store Team Leader immediately, who is then responsible for contacting the Maintenance Vendor and recording the work order number [[2](https://storage.googleapis.com/tools-universe-bucket/NRF-Store-SOP-Dec-2025/Risk%20Management%20Forklift%20Safety%20Checklist.pdf)]. This process ensures timely repairs and prevents the use of faulty equipment.

The primary objective of this policy is to enhance the wellness, safety, and morale within the stores by ensuring comprehensive tracking of potential liabilities and safety concerns [[1](https://storage.googleapis.com/tools-universe-bucket/NRF-Store-SOP-Dec-2025/Risk%20Management%20Customer%20Incident%20Reporting%20Policy.pdf)]. This proactive approach helps in identifying trends, mitigating risks, and managing potential future claims effectively.

### **Steps** ✅:
1. **Report to Insurance Claims Administrator.**
   The manager on duty (MOD) must report the incident to the Insurance Claims Administrator via email as soon as possible after it occurs [[1](https://storage.googleapis.com/tools-universe-bucket/NRF-Store-SOP-Dec-2025/Risk%20Management%20Customer%20Incident%20Reporting%20Policy.pdf)]. This initial notification is critical for initiating the claims process and ensuring that the incident is officially recorded without delay.
2. **Complete Required Forms and Gather Evidence.**
   The MOD is required to complete the "Initial Report of Injury" form and obtain "Witness Statement Forms" from any individuals who witnessed the incident [[1](https://storage.googleapis.com/tools-universe-bucket/NRF-Store-SOP-Dec-2025/Risk%20Management%20Customer%20Incident%20Reporting%20Policy.pdf)]. This comprehensive documentation provides a factual record of the incident.
3. **Submit All Paperwork.**
   All completed paperwork, including the Incident Report and Witness Statements, must be emailed to the Claims Administrator and the Risk Management department within the shift during which the incident occurred [[1](https://storage.googleapis.com/tools-universe-bucket/NRF-Store-SOP-Dec-2025/Risk%20Management%20Customer%20Incident%20Reporting%20Policy.pdf)]. Timely submission ensures that all parties are informed and can proceed with necessary actions, such as insurance claim processing.

*   **Report Distribution:** A copy of the incident report should NOT be given to the customer, as the insurance carrier will manage all correspondence related to the incident [[1](https://storage.googleapis.com/tools-universe-bucket/NRF-Store-SOP-Dec-2025/Risk%20Management%20Customer%20Incident%20Reporting%20Policy.pdf)].

This process is vital for maintaining a safe store environment and protecting the company from potential liabilities.
*   **Incident Information Form Completion**: The MOD must complete the Incident Information Form, which includes detailed fields for Store Info, Customer Info, Incident Details (Date/Time, Weather, Body Part Affected, Type of Injury, Description, Equipment/Chemicals, Specific Activity), Pet Involvement (if applicable), and Medical Info (if medical attention was sought) [[1](https://storage.googleapis.com/tools-universe-bucket/NRF-Store-SOP-Dec-2025/Risk%20Management%20Customer%20Incident%20Reporting%20Policy.pdf)].
